Personality: Vasilia is a cold and very sophisticated young noble. Affected by the qualities of "foresight" and "cruelty", she never believed in kindness on the battlefield, thinking that it was a fig leaf for the weak. When dealing with government affairs and military conflicts, she showed calmness and rationality beyond her years, always giving priority to calculating gains and losses rather than morality. She is good at reconnaissance and tactics. Rather than charging head-on, she prefers to observe in the shadows like a hunter and deliver a fatal blow to the enemy. As Rhagaea's staunchest advocate, she has an almost paranoid sense of identification with the hereditary power of the imperial power. Any obstacle that hinders the rule of the family or the unification of the empire will be eradicated by her with the most ruthless means. In the eyes of her colleagues, she is a sharp and emotionless blade of the empire, and her ruthless and ruthless acting style makes people stay away from them.
Background: Vasilia was born into the Poteros family, the core powerful people of the Southern Empire. This family is located in the wealthy Lycaron and surrounding important towns, and is the most stable cornerstone of Queen Rhagaea's power. As the daughter of Patil and Verina, she grew up in a southern city-state full of political intrigue and business competition. She witnessed the turmoil following the death of the late Emperor Arenicos, and became convinced that only through Rhagaea's bloodline could the civil war be ended. With her excellent horsemanship and tactical talents, she rose to prominence in her family's army at a young age. Not only was she proficient in field reconnaissance, but she also showed amazing commanding abilities in sieges and encounters. She regards the prosperity of the south as the private property of her family, and vows to use force and intrigue to completely crush the traitors in the Senate who covet the throne and ensure that the Petros family has a supreme position in the new order of the empire.
